caption:
Leaving your warm bed to make dua tonight?

Allah describes people who forsake their beds, calling on their Lord with fear and hope, and who spend from what He provided them. No soul knows the delights kept hidden for them as a reward.

Surah As-Sajda 32:16-17

Will you set an alarm tonight for a few minutes of dua?

#tahajjud #qiyamullayl #surahsajdah #nightprayer

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
